geometry.locator: OSM way 608881797 (building:part, roof:shape=dome) as of 2026-10-25T11:13:24Z; node/257712288 (power=generator, BWR-1, 1220 MW) as of 2026-10-25T11:12:21Z
geometry.note: Identification by tags, not by name: this is the only dome-roofed building part in the plant and the OSM generator node of the plant (generator:type BWR-1, 1220 MW, ref 'Leibstadt') lies 7 m from its centroid inside it. Replaces the earlier proximity pick (way 567961020, a 1319 m2 building 190 m SSW of the generator node), which is not the reactor building. Dome outline: area 1719 m2, circular part radius 23.0 m (diameter 46.0 m); its west side is flattened in the OSM tracing.

method: OpenStreetMap way 608881797 (building:part, roof:shape=dome, 18 vertices) kept verbatim. Identified as the reactor building because it is the only dome-roofed part of the plant and the plant's OSM power=generator node (node/257712288, BWR-1, 1220 MW) is 7 m from its centroid; no official outline or dimension of the reactor building was found, so there is no checks[] row and the shape stays 'approximate'.
name: Leibstadt Nuclear Power Plant reactor building (dome-roofed OSM building part)
notes: Release geometry (underground): the earlier record (way 567961020, picked as the largest building near the plant's bus-stop node) was a different building; it is no longer drawn.
entity_id is the plant campus site so the map accounts for the detector-hosting site; the reactor building is the structure the CONUS+ detector sits in.

summary.plain: The dome-roofed reactor building of the Leibstadt Nuclear Power Plant, inside which the CONUS+ detector sits about 21 m from the reactor core.
